$description: Contrast targets enforced by check T6 per pair kind (text, large-text, ui). APCA is reported for information only.

presets.label: WCAG 2.2 AA
presets.description: The legal baseline in most places: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text and UI parts. The default.

presets.label: WCAG 2.2 AAA
presets.description: Enhanced contrast for text; harder to meet with colorful brands.

presets.label: APCA (information)
presets.description: Lightness contrast values a future WCAG may use. Shown next to WCAG results when contrast.apca is true; not enforced.
